title: Phase 0.3: The Lab reads as future tense, 'Frequency Labs' is 'Frequency', Crew stops promising free-for-everyone, and the category line is R1's

source.ref: §14 Phase 0.3 (The Lab and naming); rulings R1, R2, R8 in §12

detail:
What is Frequency, its metadata and /llms.txt described The Lab as a room you can walk into today ('the physical third space the community gathers in', 'the first Lab is taking root', 'gather at The Lab') while /the-lab says it is planned for 2028; tools-for-community-builders called the software 'Frequency Labs'; Who Frequency is for and What is Frequency sold Crew as what keeps Frequency 'free for everyone' (R2 ends comped Crew at launch, R8 positions Crew as support first); SITE_DESCRIPTION and llms.txt opened on 'Frequency is a Community Collective', which R1 retires as the category line; llms.txt still carried the dormant 'Opening Beta rate under the $X list' branch.

Shipped 2026-10-13 (copy only, no behaviour or billing change): lib/site.ts gains CATEGORY_LINE = 'Local groups that keep meeting.' (R1) and SITE_DESCRIPTION opens on it; SITE_TAGLINE stays 'Community Collective' (the logo lockup). /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt open their summaries on CATEGORY_LINE, put The Lab in 2028, and the ladder sentence drops the Opening Beta branch. What is Frequency (template + metadata) leads with the category line and states The Lab as planned to open in 2028, not open yet, nothing bookable; tools-for-community-builders says 'Frequency' and links 'See the plan for The Lab'; the Crew line reads 'back Frequency with Crew. The host kit and a monthly Boost come with it.' R1 is followed over NAMING.md §ADR-811/944 for SITE_DESCRIPTION (ADR-1735 amends ADR-944).
